courses.name: Small Category RPC (2–25 kg)
courses.shortDesc: Complete commercial remote pilot certification for standard multirotor and aerial survey drones.
courses.description: The foundational commercial drone pilot license certified by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). Covers micro to small category UAVs (up to 25 kg), flight mechanics, airspace management, and mission planning.
syllabus: Day 1: DGCA Drone Rules 2021, Airspace, ATC Protocols & Meteorology
Day 2: Simulator Cockpit Sessions & Emergency Fail-Safe Scenarios
Day 3: Drone Sub-systems, Battery Safety & Pre-flight Inspection SOPs
Day 4: Solo Flight Maneuvers, Figure of 8 & Payload Simulation
Day 5: DGCA Skill Test, Practical Flight Exam & Viva Voce
prerequisites: 10th Standard Pass from a recognized board

courses.name: Medium Category RPC (25–150 kg)
courses.shortDesc: Specialized commercial training for heavy agricultural spraying and cargo delivery drones.
courses.description: Comprehensive DGCA certification for operating heavy-lift and agricultural drones (25 kg to 150 kg). Training includes automated precision spraying calibrations, radar obstacle avoidance, and battery swarm logistics.
highlights: Heavy Agri Sprayer (10L–30L Payload) Flight Practice
Digital Sky RPTO Authorization for Medium Class
syllabus: Day 1: Heavy UAV Dynamics, DGCA Weight Classification & Regulations
Day 2: Medium Category Simulator Labs with Wind Drift & Payload Shift
Day 3: Agri-Payload Calibration, Nozzle Flow Rates & RTK Setup
Day 4: Field Spraying Missions, Waypoint Flight & Obstacle Evasion
Day 5: Practical DGCA Flying Assessment & Medium Category RPC Issue

courses.name: Small Category Upgrade (RPC)
courses.weightClass: For Existing Micro / Basic Pilot Holders
courses.shortDesc: Bridge course for existing micro category pilots upgrading to official Small Category RPC.
courses.description: Accelerated 3-day conversion program for pilots who already possess basic UAV training or micro category credentials, fast-tracking to a full Small Category DGCA commercial license.
syllabus: Day 1: Advanced DGCA Airspace Directives & 25kg Aerodynamics
Day 2: Complex Flight Simulations & Cross-Wind Hover Exercises
Day 3: DGCA Flight Skill Evaluation & Certificate Endorsement
prerequisites: Valid Micro Category or Prior Flight Logbook

courses.name: Medium Category Upgrade (RPC)
courses.shortDesc: Direct qualification upgrade for Small RPC holders entering heavy agriculture & cargo sectors.
courses.description: Specialized 3-day bridge training designed for certified Small Category pilots wishing to command medium category UAVs (25kg - 150kg) for agribusiness and infrastructure contracts.
highlights: 3 Days Targeted Field Flight on Heavy Hexacopters
Agri Spraying & Liquid Slosh Dynamics Management
Immediate License Category Endorsement on Digital Sky
syllabus: Day 1: Heavy Class Systems, Fail-safes & Payload Physics
Day 2: 30L Agri Drone Flight Operations & RTK Auto-Mission
Day 3: Practical Exam & Medium Category License Endorsement
prerequisites: Active Small Category DGCA RPC License

courses.name: Small + Medium Category Combo
courses.shortDesc: Ultimate dual-category master program certifying you for both standard commercial UAVs and heavy agricultural aircraft.
courses.description: The premier career launchpad at Sri Eshwar Drone Tech. In 7 intensive days, obtain dual DGCA Remote Pilot Certificates for both Small (2–25 kg) and Medium (25–150 kg) categories. Save ₹8,000+ with bundled training, simulator access, and industrial field attachments.
highlights: Dual DGCA Pilot Licenses in One Program
Certified for Surveying, Mapping & Agri Spraying
Free Industrial Thermography & GIS Overview Module
Priority Placement Assistance with Drone Ecosystem Partners
syllabus: Days 1–3: Complete Small Category Ground School, Simulator & Solo Flight
Days 4–5: Medium Category Dynamics, Agri Payloads, RTK & Spraying Lab
Day 6: Advanced Industrial Scenarios (Solar/Wind Surveying demo)
Day 7: Dual DGCA Practical Examinations & License Submission
